inspection.pixels: Three circles in one horizontal row. Each has center O, horizontal radius ending at A on the right circumference, and a vertical line p. Left: line p is outside the circle, B is on p beyond A, upper h spans O to B, lower r spans O to A, h>r. Middle: p is tangent at A, both spans end at A, h=r. Right: p crosses the circle left of A; B lies on p on the horizontal center-to-A radius; upper h spans O to B and lower r spans O to A, h<r. The source case captions are Cyrillic and run left to right.
inspection.preservation: Keep all three circles, O/A/B identities, p lines, span endpoints, inequalities and case order. English modern labels are permitted; no geometry or given-data change is authorized.
